introduction: Florida LIHEAP helps eligible households with home heating or cooling bills. Applications go to the provider serving your county, not a single statewide benefit portal.
description: Florida LIHEAP helps eligible households with home heating or cooling bills. Applications go to the provider serving your county, not a single statewide benefit portal.

sections.who: Applicants must meet Florida residency, household financial and status rules and be responsible for home energy costs. The local provider checks the current rules and available funding.
sections.get: Assistance is paid to the utility on the household’s behalf. It is energy assistance: Florida’s program does not pay water, sewer or telephone bills.
sections.docs:
• Your most recent home-energy bill.
  • Any final termination or disconnection notice.
  • Current income records for household members.
  • Applicant identification and the household identity or status records requested by the provider.
sections.apply:
1. Locate the county provider

    Use FloridaCommerce’s provider directory.

  2. Check local intake

    Some county providers offer an online application. If none is listed, contact the agency directly for its process and appointment availability.

  3. Explain urgent circumstances

    Give the provider the shutoff date and notice. Ask the utility separately about an arrangement while the application is being considered.
sections.after: Ask the provider whether assistance was approved and sent to the utility. An application alone does not confirm payment or stop a shutoff.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Florida LIHEAP overview, County provider directory. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can LIHEAP pay a water bill?
Florida’s LIHEAP page excludes water, sewer and telephone costs. Ask 211 about other assistance.
Does FloridaCommerce decide my application directly?
Local county providers process applications and assistance.
What if the county has no online form?
Call the provider listed for your county to ask how to apply.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
